core.note: Read proposal status wording alongside current RUN_OPEN/GRANT acceptance; no expansion to reports/WS.

wire.note: Accepted content digest pinned; 12 domain operations, no report or WS wire surface.

agents.note: Repository case-requirement mapping; physical targets are not measured results.

journal_semantics.note: Current accepted clarifications supplied in C-105 GRANT brief: moving scoped keyset pages; representative lowest-number active order; queued-only counts; scoped roles; absent assessment and null human score.

cases.title: Two-session assembled lifecycle
steps: Operator signs into separate browser contexts using provisioned synthetic master/executor accounts; inspect /me without retaining its CSRF value. Record verified user_id, role and section only.
Master issues an unplanned synthetic order through the Russian UI with a genuinely future domain deadline. Do not replay historical seed through live create.
Executor receives the same order, accepts, starts, pauses with a reason, resumes, stages actual sanitized synthetic after-photo bytes and submits a complete result through the UI.
Master inspects immutable attempt, clearly labeled AI mode/recommendation or absence, then makes a reasoned human close decision. Reload both contexts and inspect persisted current state/history.
Record order/submission/event IDs and versions in sanitized evidence; obtain A0 isolated-DB evidence reference for actual persistence. Do not restart/reset services in this suite.

checks.expectation: Two distinct verified sessions with correct scopes; no mock/service-worker canned responses
Real create response and same order ID appear in executor UI; future due_at preserved
Accept/start/pause/resume each reach real backend; reason/history survive reload
Real photo stage and immutable submission; committed snapshot is ai_review, not externally persistent done
Only master closes current complete attempt with reason; AI does not auto-close; null final_score remains unscored
Reload matches current authorized backend snapshot/history; A0 references real isolated DB durability evidence for candidate SHA

dependencies: Assembled frontend and mounted business routes
Provisioned synthetic roles and photo fixture

cases.title: Incomplete result and rework remain distinct from AI score
steps: On a separate unplanned order, submit nonblank work with missing after-photo and/or null work_code_id. A deliberately incomplete attempt is allowed on the accepted contract.

Inspect missing_evidence. Attempt close through the actual UI, or record the real server denial reached from that browser under A0-approved negative-test procedure. Hidden close button alone does not prove the backend guard.
Master returns with reason; executor starts rework, adds required evidence and submits a new attempt; inspect both immutable attempts.
Inspect absence of assessment separately from model/rules/manual mode. Do not infer pending or failed solely from assessments=[].

checks.expectation: Explicit incomplete attempt and safe missing-evidence UI; transport success does not mean complete work
Real backend denies incomplete close with 409 INCOMPLETE_SUBMISSION regardless of score; no false closed UI
New attempt ID after rework, old attempt retained, no silent in-place mutation
Empty assessments are absent; null human final_score is neither AI score nor zero

cases.title: Browser permissions and identity switch
steps: Use only provisioned synthetic test objects: own order/photo, other-executor order and foreign-section order. Capture authorized baseline in the correct actor context.
Open actual assembled UI deep links in other executor/foreign master/manager/admin contexts. Reuse real observed URL shapes; invent no route.
Observe unauthorized object/photo denial from real backend; verify no protected object fields or previous authorized cached screen are shown. A missing button by itself is insufficient.
For manager/admin writes, attach A0 real-server boundary evidence plus assembled UI denial. This suite does not duplicate API fuzzing or DB acceptance.

With a pending draft/unknown command, logout and sign in as another provisioned user in the same device/profile. Observe explicit isolation and no old outbox replay under new identity; do not silently discard prior pending work.

checks.expectation: Known forbidden order/photo reads return 403 without protected content; no cached object flash
Manager is read-only; admin gains no implicit production order read/write; attach A0 backend evidence for this candidate
Identity loss clears/isolate previous read cache and pending work; no second-user transmission of prior commands/photos

cases.title: Committed response lost before browser receipt
steps: Use a disposable synthetic order and an explicitly authorized isolated fault-injection seam. Begin observation before the UI mutation.

Allow a real request to reach the real backend and commit. Drop only its response before the application receives it. Preserve sanitized route, action, operation_id, expected_version, body digest and committed original response/version/event IDs.
If the seam cannot prove commit-before-drop, mark BLOCKED. Going offline before send or fabricating a success response does not exercise this failure.

Check UI says outcome unknown and preserves intent. Invoke its retry without editing. Observe identical operation_id, route, expected_version and canonical payload digest; compare original receipt body/status/event IDs.
Reconcile latest authorized snapshot after replay; old receipt snapshot is not necessarily current. Inspect A0 isolated-DB evidence for one effect; this harness never queries/resets DB.

checks.expectation: Actual committed response was suppressed; evidence identifies authorized seam and A0 commit proof, with secrets removed
No success before confirmation; form/pending intent retained; distinguish known-not-sent from unknown outcome
Real UI retry reuses operation and canonical request; original response status/body/version/event IDs returned
A0 evidence proves one committed effect; UI reconciles current authorized snapshot without duplicate history

dependencies: Explicit approved commit-then-drop seam and A0 real-DB inspection; not supplied by this harness

cases.title: Reconnect and status convergence
steps: Keep master viewing a real assigned order and executor in a separate context. Record real monotonic timing, not accelerated domain time.
Disconnect only master browser network; executor makes an allowed real transition. UI must display disconnected/stale state, not empty data or sent success.
Reconnect master. Drain real event pages using has_more/next_after_sequence and reconcile authorized snapshot. Repeated events may be delivered but not rendered twice.

Measure a separate online executor-commit-to-master-visible transition against <=5s. Record reconnect-to-reconciled duration separately; the contract specifies reconciliation, not a separate numerical reconnect SLA.
If using polling, record observed requests and cadence. No accepted WS wire contract exists; do not substitute a fabricated WS server.

checks.expectation: Disconnected state honest; no data loss or fake empty list
After reconnect event sequence and current snapshot converge without duplicate UI history
Measured online committed change to visible master UI includes sample size, timing boundary and network conditions

cases.title: Stale version preserves the user intent
steps: Load the same authorized order in two separate master contexts, or advance it via executor while master retains an old version.
Submit an allowed stale-version UI action. A nonstale AI assessment can also legitimately advance aggregate version; do not confuse it with event sequence.
Inspect real 409 and current authorized state. Preserve entered reason/form values and offer explicit user resolution; never silently overwrite or automatically switch operation ID.
Only after operator resolves a new intent may a new operation ID and current expected_version be used. Record real request/response pairing.

checks.expectation: Real VERSION_CONFLICT or accepted conflict mapping is visible with retained input and current authorized state
New operation ID appears only for explicitly resolved new intent; original conflict is not hidden as success

cases.title: Scoped catalogues, moving pages and honest nulls
steps: Use C1/A6-provisioned synthetic fixtures with multiple in_progress/paused orders for one executor, queued orders, and null/absent scores; do not create a second importer.
Compare actual scoped dictionary/list responses with assembled UI for master/manager, executor self and admin.
Browse more than one scoped keyset page while another permitted session changes an order. Check no cross-page total/snapshot promise is inferred; obtain known fixture expectations from A0.
Check active_order_id is lowest-number representative among visible in_progress/paused, multiple active orders are allowed; queue_count counts queued only and zero does not establish free capacity.

checks.expectation: Master/manager catalogues scoped, executor self-only, admin no workload rows
Representative active order and queued-only count retain their distinct meanings; no false free badge
No stable total or cross-page snapshot claim from moving scoped keyset pages
Absent assessments remain absent; null human score remains unscored in assembled displays

cases.title: Report continuation gap
steps: Accepted proposal.2 has no report endpoint. Obtain accepted report contract, assembled route and authorization before executing; invent no /reports URL.
After real human decision, open the actual report UI through verified navigation in each authorized role; compare order/attempt/review facts to real backend and explicit source IDs.
Clearly distinguish live report, historical/offline synthetic rendering and null human score. Inspect unauthorized read denial under the accepted follow-on contract.

checks.expectation: Actual assembled role-scoped report reconciles to current authorized backend and immutable human decision

dependencies: Accepted report API and assembled view absent from core; C4 offline output does not close live report gate

cases.title: Physical Android create timing
steps: On physical Android in Russian, record model/OS/browser/viewport/network and whether PWA installed. Keep synthetic-data watermark visible.

Freeze timing/tap protocol before trial: start when opening a fresh create form, stop at confirmed issuance; count discrete UI taps, record typing/keyboard interactions separately and disclose all prefilled values.

Run a real issue into the other synthetic session. Record sample count, each duration/tap count, failures and whether camera/typing were included. One run is a demonstration, not a population estimate.

checks.expectation: Physical Android issue measured with explicit prefill/text/camera method; <=60 seconds and <=6 UI taps

dependencies: Human-operated physical Android; emulated viewport is insufficient

cases.title: Physical camera and real mobile upload
steps: Operator handles Android camera permission and captures only authorized synthetic scene; never real staff/documents. Record both granted and denied permission behavior.

Upload real compressed/sanitized bytes through assembled app on a specified mobile network. Measure selection/compression/upload and total time separately; record original/sent byte counts and media type.

Verify actual stage/attachment and protected authorized image display. A0 validates stored byte sanitization/EXIF policy; source photo filename or browser preview alone proves neither upload nor privacy.

checks.expectation: Physical camera allow/deny behavior is usable and does not fabricate captured/uploaded state
Actual mobile photo upload completes <=10 seconds under fully described network/timing conditions
Real attached private image and A0 sanitized-storage evidence for exact candidate

dependencies: Device operator and camera permission; explicit synthetic photo consent

cases.title: Actual notification delivery and permission denial
steps: Obtain explicit approved channel and synthetic test phone recipients; no real employee messages, new provider spend or notification subscription implied by this suite.
Operator grants/denies native notification permissions. Trigger approved new-order and overdue notification to intended role with visible domain-time mode.
Observe delivery on physical locked/backgrounded Android; record actual receive time and sound/vibration conditions separately from provider accepted/sent.
When permission is denied or channel unavailable, assembled UI explains limitation; live polling/banner is not claimed as phone push.

checks.expectation: Actual approved new-order/overdue phone receipt for intended roles; provider receipt alone insufficient
Observed sound/vibration explicitly conditioned on device permissions/mute/DND; no universal bypass claim
Denied permissions/channel failure have honest UI and no fabricated delivered badge

dependencies: Approved channel/recipients and physical phone; no real dispatch performed in C-105

cases.title: Physical Android background/reconnect/account boundary
steps: On actual Android with real app origin, background or lock during a pending command, lose network, then resume. Record whether the browser sent anything before disconnection.
Reconcile same-intent unknown outcome using accepted replay behavior. A separate not-sent case must say not sent; neither becomes fictitious completion.
With pending work, change to the other provisioned identity via real logout/login. Inspect installed PWA/cache behavior and confirm no old-user content or replay reaches new session.

checks.expectation: Physical background/network/resume converges honestly with no duplicate visible effect
Installed/mobile cache and pending work remain account isolated after real session change

dependencies: Physical Android and provisioning; device lifecycle cannot be concluded from desktop unit tests
